name: A - Labor Watch
description: Labor-domain collector in the macro-monitoring swarm. Watches Non-Farm Payrolls, ADP, JOLTS, Jobless Claims and the UK Labour Market report; logs prints to the Macro Monitor blackboard and alerts #hyper-asset-monitoring on new releases / material surprises.

scheduledInvocations.name: Release check — morning
scheduledInvocations.prompt: Scheduled release check. (1) DEDUP: read the Macro Monitor blackboard (doc cmq5rqdws16qq06adoiw88r03), the Labor section; note the latest logged date per report. (2) CHECK each of your official sources for a release newer than logged (use the browser if a source blocks plain fetch). (3) NEW release -> capture headline + key sub-readings, consensus, prior, surprise (mark 'unconfirmed' if not verifiable); append a row to your section table; update Current stance; post a concise alert to #hyper-asset-monitoring (C0B8B76L7NH). (4) HEARTBEAT (ALWAYS, even if nothing new): set the section's 'Last checked' line to the current time (ET) with status 'logged <report>' or 'no new release'. Never post to Slack on a no-new-release run.
